# uptrace_team (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace team within an organization. Teams are a Premium feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_team" "example" {
  org_id     = uptrace_org.example.id
  name       = "platform"
  perm_level = "edit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID this team belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `perm_level` (String) Project permission override applied to all team members: none, view, edit, or admin. Omitting this attribute lets the backend default apply (currently view) and the result is reflected in state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_team.example 123:456
```
